summary_en: 280,000 shares (5.62% of S/O) at ¥5,000/share; ¥1.4B total; ToSTNeT-3 on 2026-08-21 (08:30–08:50 JST, single window). Concurrent cancellation of 740,000 shares (12.89% of pre-cancel issued shares) effective 2026-08-31; post-cancel issued shares 5,000,000.
title_en: Notice on Acquisition of Treasury Stock and Purchase via Off-Hours Treasury Stock Acquisition Transaction, and Cancellation of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: On 2026-08-20, the board of Loginet Japan (9027, Sapporo Exchange) resolved to acquire up to 280,000 treasury shares via off-hours transaction (ToSTNeT-3) on 2026-08-21 at the closing price of ¥5,000/share (final special bid included), for a total not to exceed ¥1.4 billion. The purchase order is valid only for the specified trading window (08:30–08:50 JST). The 280,000-share buyback represents 5.62% of shares outstanding (ex-treasury denominator: 4,980,183 shares as of 2026-08-20). Concurrently, the board resolved to cancel 740,000 treasury shares effective 2026-08-31, reducing issued shares from 5,740,000 to 5,000,000 (the 740,000 cancellation is 12.89% of the pre-cancellation issued count). The stated purpose is to enhance per-share value and shareholder returns while improving capital efficiency.
